description: This file defines the GoogleCalendarService class, which provides methods to retrieve and update Google Calendar events, handling authentication via OAuth2 and delegation credentials, and integrating with a booking references repository.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarService
classes.description: Service class for managing Google Calendar events, including retrieving event details and updating events, with support for delegated credentials and OAuth authentication.

methods.name: getEventDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Google Calendar event by its UID.

methods.name: updateEventDetails
methods.description: Updates a Google Calendar event with new data.

methods.name: getAuthorizedCalendarInstance
methods.description: Obtains an authorized Google Calendar API client, using delegation credentials if available, otherwise falling back to OAuth credentials.

methods.name: getDelegatedCalendarInstance
methods.description: Creates a delegated Google Calendar client using a service account and impersonation.
